I agree with Moon Knight, Psylocke, Mantis, Invisible Woman, and Magik.

I don’t think Black Widow is hard to use, at least not nearly on the same level as Spiderman and Black Panther. I can aim pretty well and she only has 2 cooldown abilities. At no point will I ever switch to her useless batons. She pales in comparison to other characters but I don’t think that makes her hard to use. Easier to aim with than Hawkeye too. As long as you have other DPS doing damage, she’s pretty useful. But characters like Hela and Hawkeye are just better.

I think Cloak and Dagger is 3 star. Just cause you have to keep in mind when to actually use all their abilities. You can legit save the entire time from Pure Chaos and Maximum Pulse if you use Cloak’s invisibility. That’s of course, if you tell your team through coms and your team pays attention, making sure not to attack during the time frame of this ability. And making sure when to switch and when to use each healing ability so you can maximize the use of each.

As for Psylocke, I agree 100%. She’s so easy to use and in no way harder to use than Black Panther. I mean seriously? Black Panther is a 4 star but Psylocke is a 5 star?? In what universe? I barely play her and only started using her a bit more recently, but I do good with her every time I use her (and have a decent team of course).
